sources.fullCitation: Tanz-Orchester Dajos Béla, vocal by Luigi Bernauer, credited on the label as Fred Lustig. “Signorina, ich liebe dich.” Tango; label credits Walter Jurmann, Bronislaw Kaper and Ernst Marischka. Odeon, n.d. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube.

sources.researchNote: The uploader dates the issue to 1932 and associates the side with Hochzeitsreise zu dritt. The filmed label directly confirms Odeon O-11768 b, matrix Be 10147, Dajos Béla, Fred Lustig and the Kaper–Jurmann–Marischka credits, but carries no year. The Odeon label list gives 1933 in its general year column and its separate release-date column is empty. The structured date retains the uploader’s 1932 as disputed, not confirmed: the catalogue’s 1933 does not by itself establish a precise issue or session date. The examined label does not name Monopol-Liederverlag; that publisher credit rests on a separate printed source.

sources.shortCitation: YouTube, Dajos Béla, “Du liebst mich nicht mehr”
sources.fullCitation: “Du liebst mich nicht mehr.” Slow-fox. YouTube transfer published by Radiomuseum Hardthausen; the uploader identifies Tanz-Orchester Dajos Béla, reports a Berlin recording in 1932 and gives the music credit “Bob Henders”.
sources.title: Du liebst mich nicht mehr — Dajos Béla, YouTube
sources.creator: Tanz-Orchester Dajos Béla
sources.researchNote: The upload reports a music credit to Bob Henders, a Berlin recording in 1932 and an Odeon first issue, but supplies no catalogue or matrix number. It shows a portrait from a Funk-Almanach rather than the label. Henry König’s Odeon label list separately documents this title with Dajos Béla as O-11667, Be 9946, recorded on 10 June 1932 in Berlin, Schlesische Straße 26, room 4; the release-date column is empty. The same list also assigns Be 9946 to the different title “Heute Nacht oder nie!”, an unresolved matrix inconsistency. The upload has not been matched to a verified pressing or take; neither O-11667 nor the exact session date is assigned to it. The structured year remains the uploader-reported recording year, not a confirmed issue date. The name Bob Henders in these recording descriptions does not by itself resolve the work’s authorship.

contributions.scopeNote: The filmed Odeon O-11768 b label in SRC0754 names Tanz-Orchester Dajos Béla. This documents the performing ensemble; the linked upload description does not establish the recording location.

Henry König’s Odeon label list documents this title under Dajos Béla and his orchestra. It provides independent evidence of the ensemble’s recording, but the list’s conflicting Be 9946 assignments do not establish the exact master or identify the uploaded transfer.
